name: battlegame
description: Repo task runner and Git hook owner. Thin aliases over cargo (Rust) and the web app's own bun scripts; a bare script runs the whole job and a :suffix runs one part.

scripts.setup: bun install && bun install --cwd web && bun run --cwd web install-browsers && bun run --cwd web check-prerequisites
scripts.dev: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:mechanics && bun run build:map-workbench && bun run --cwd web dev
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:web
scripts.lint: bun run lint:complexity && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && web/node_modules/.bin/oxlint -c web/.oxlintrc.json packages apps web
scripts.fmt: cargo fmt --all && web/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --write packages apps web/src web/tests web/scenes web/scene.mjs web/scene.test.mjs web/capture web/capture.mjs web/capture.test.mjs web/browser.mjs web/browser.test.mjs web/browser.d.mts web/asset.mjs web/asset-render.mjs web/vite.config.ts web/vitest.config.ts web/eslint.config.mjs lint-staged.config.mjs
scripts.fmt:check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && web/node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check packages apps web/src web/tests web/scenes web/scene.mjs web/scene.test.mjs web/capture web/capture.mjs web/capture.test.mjs web/browser.mjs web/browser.test.mjs web/browser.d.mts web/asset.mjs web/asset-render.mjs web/vite.config.ts web/vitest.config.ts web/eslint.config.mjs lint-staged.config.mjs
scripts.test: bun run test:rust && bun run test:web
scripts.test:web: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:mechanics && bun run build:map-workbench && bun run --cwd web test
scripts.verify: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:mechanics && bun run build:map-workbench && bun run --cwd web verify
scripts.visual: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:mechanics && bun run build:map-workbench && bun run --cwd web visual
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run build:wasm && bun run build:mechanics && bun run build:map-workbench && bun run typecheck && bun run test:rust && bun run --cwd web test
